---
title: "Projects"

## Practice Hustle Dashboard

Built an R Shiny + Quarto dashboard for Virginia Tech Women’s Basketball to track practice hustle metrics, automate reports, and visualize player performance trends.

Public materials use anonymized or altered data to preserve team confidentiality.

## Scouting Card & Badge System

Automated basketball scouting cards using Synergy playtype data, percentile grading logic, and custom R visualization workflows.

## TipOffBall NBA/WNBA Analysis

Build NBA and WNBA analytics workflows in R using Synergy and NBA Stats API data for player evaluation, playoff analysis, and basketball data visualization.

## Shot Quality Pipeline

Built a prototype shot quality pipeline using NBA Stats API play-by-play and shot chart data to model contextual shot value.
